message:
test(sql): cover NULL lag and lead defaults across partitions (#30020)

## What type of PR is this?

- [x] Test and CI

## Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #29925

## What this PR does / why we need it:

Adds regression coverage for LAG/LEAD explicit NULL defaults across
partitions of sizes two and one. The cleanup fix already merged in
#29918 clears payload-free NULL-vector lengths; these tests verify the
reported SQL behavior and protect that reuse contract.

SQL tests check untyped NULL, typed DOUBLE NULL, omitted, zero and
row-dependent defaults, asserting every value and NULL bit. Vector
coverage adds DOUBLE and shrinking, empty and growing lengths, retaining
provenance and memory-cleanup assertions. Production code is unchanged.

Validation: focused normal and race checks passed 11 top-level tests per
mode across vector, window and SQL integration, including all ten new
SQL cases and existing cancellation/error/lifecycle controls, with no
skips or race reports. Incremental gofmt and go vet passed; configured
golangci-lint reported 0 issues. Molint ran over the same three
packages; its two unsafe-import diagnostics are in unchanged files
verified byte-identical to the base.

Tests used Go 1.27.1, CGO_ENABLED=1 and fresh native artifacts. Local
SQL fixtures used a diagnostic configuration overlay changing only the
Unix socket pathname to avoid Linux path-length limits; TCP query
execution and assertions were unchanged. The final gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh
review accepted the exact committed candidate. Remote CI remains
pending.

Closes #29925
